name: Pluepet
source:
Mysterious creature, head of Pluepet Trading Firm of space traders. If you have enough money and resources, it can get anything: strangest items in Universe; most dangerous weapons, that humanity has known; from most beautiful woman in the world to the most muscular man in the world. Has rather specific accent.

"Hey, no, these words are scandalous, yees. We just sell what countries need and asks for."
